description: A tall, multicolored tower of large soft Lego-style blocks stands on a wooden table, with extra blocks forming a base around it. The right hand reaches in from the right and presses against the upper part of the tower, pushing it left until the stack tips over and collapses; then both hands move toward the scattered pieces, with the left hand gathering blocks near the fallen stack while the right hand picks up and shifts loose blocks to spread them out for disassembly.
